description: Compare and focus observed provider/model routes. Operational success is not accepted-task correctness. Use the Provider and Model dropdowns to isolate a set.

options.content:
Use **Provider** and **Model** at the top to compare a set or focus one route. Missing `provider`+`model` tags are **untagged**.

Bars and tables are mechanical: TTFT, cost, turn/tool errors, USD per 1k output tokens. `status=ok` is not accepted-task correctness. Do not read these as TPS or quality. Pair with `npm run telemetry:review -- --models` for p50/p95.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value
FROM server_ops_metric_samples
WHERE metric = 'server.turn_duration_ms'
  AND ts_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider')), ''), 'untagged') IN (${provider:sqlstring})
  AND (CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider'), '')), '') IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.model'), '')), '') IS NULL THEN 'untagged' ELSE json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider') || '/' || json_extract(tags_json, '$.model') END) IN (${route:sqlstring})

panels.description: Mechanical turn error rate by selected route. Not accepted-task correctness.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT
  CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider'), '')), '') IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.model'), '')), '') IS NULL THEN 'untagged' ELSE json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider') || '/' || json_extract(tags_json, '$.model') END AS route,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'server.turn_error' THEN value ELSE 0 END)
    / MAX(1, SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'server.turn_duration_ms' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)),
    1
  ) AS turn_err_pct
FROM server_ops_metric_samples
WHERE metric IN ('server.turn_error', 'server.turn_duration_ms')
  AND ts_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider')), ''), 'untagged') IN (${provider:sqlstring})
  AND (CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider'), '')), '') IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.model'), '')), '') IS NULL THEN 'untagged' ELSE json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider') || '/' || json_extract(tags_json, '$.model') END) IN (${route:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'server.turn_duration_ms' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY turn_err_pct DESC

panels.description: SUM(turn_cost) / SUM(turn_output_tokens) as USD per 1k output tokens. Efficiency, not quality. Both series are sum-aggregated.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT
  CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider'), '')), '') IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.model'), '')), '') IS NULL THEN 'untagged' ELSE json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider') || '/' || json_extract(tags_json, '$.model') END AS route,
  ROUND(
    SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'server.turn_cost' THEN value ELSE 0 END)
    / MAX(1.0, SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'server.turn_output_tokens' THEN value ELSE 0 END) * 1000.0),
    4
  ) AS usd_per_1k_out
FROM server_ops_metric_samples
WHERE metric IN ('server.turn_cost', 'server.turn_output_tokens')
  AND ts_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider')), ''), 'untagged') IN (${provider:sqlstring})
  AND (CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider'), '')), '') IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.model'), '')), '') IS NULL THEN 'untagged' ELSE json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider') || '/' || json_extract(tags_json, '$.model') END) IN (${route:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'server.turn_output_tokens' THEN value ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY usd_per_1k_out DESC

panels.description: Observed cost over time for the selected routes. One series per route.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT
  ((ts_ms / ${__interval_ms}) * ${__interval_ms}) / 1000 AS time,
  CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider'), '')), '') IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.model'), '')), '') IS NULL THEN 'untagged' ELSE json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider') || '/' || json_extract(tags_json, '$.model') END AS route,
  SUM(value) / 1000000.0 AS cost_usd
FROM server_ops_metric_samples
WHERE metric = 'server.turn_cost'
  AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to}
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider')), ''), 'untagged') IN (${provider:sqlstring})
  AND (CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider'), '')), '') IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.model'), '')), '') IS NULL THEN 'untagged' ELSE json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider') || '/' || json_extract(tags_json, '$.model') END) IN (${route:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider')), ''), 'untagged') AS provider,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'server.turn_duration_ms' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS turns,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'server.turn_cost' THEN value ELSE 0 END) / 1000000.0, 2) AS cost_usd,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'server.turn_ttft_ms' THEN value END), 0) AS ttft_avg_ms,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'server.turn_error' THEN value ELSE 0 END)
    / MAX(1, SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'server.turn_duration_ms' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)),
    1
  ) AS turn_err_pct,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'server.tool_result' AND json_extract(tags_json, '$.status') = 'error' THEN value ELSE 0 END)
    / MAX(1, SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'server.tool_result' THEN value ELSE 0 END)),
    1
  ) AS tool_err_pct
FROM server_ops_metric_samples
WHERE metric IN ('server.turn_ttft_ms','server.turn_duration_ms','server.turn_error','server.turn_cost','server.tool_result')
  AND ts_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider')), ''), 'untagged') IN (${provider:sqlstring})
  AND (CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider'), '')), '') IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.model'), '')), '') IS NULL THEN 'untagged' ELSE json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider') || '/' || json_extract(tags_json, '$.model') END) IN (${route:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY CASE WHEN provider = 'untagged' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, cost_usd DESC, turns DESC

panels.description: Mechanical tool failures across the selected routes.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(json_extract(tags_json, '$.tool')), ''), 'unknown') AS tool,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'server.tool_result' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS calls,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'server.tool_result' AND json_extract(tags_json, '$.status') = 'error' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS errors,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'server.tool_result' AND json_extract(tags_json, '$.status') = 'error' THEN value ELSE 0 END)
    / MAX(1, SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'server.tool_result' THEN value ELSE 0 END)),
    1
  ) AS err_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'server.tool_duration_ms' THEN value END), 0) AS duration_avg_ms
FROM server_ops_metric_samples
WHERE metric IN ('server.tool_result', 'server.tool_duration_ms')
  AND ts_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider')), ''), 'untagged') IN (${provider:sqlstring})
  AND (CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider'), '')), '') IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.model'), '')), '') IS NULL THEN 'untagged' ELSE json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider') || '/' || json_extract(tags_json, '$.model') END) IN (${route:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1
HAVING calls > 0
ORDER BY errors DESC, calls DESC

panels.title: Tool errors

panels.description: Exact provider/model comparison for the selected set. Averages only; p50/p95 stay in telemetry:review --models.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT
  CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider'), '')), '') IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.model'), '')), '') IS NULL THEN 'untagged' ELSE json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider') || '/' || json_extract(tags_json, '$.model') END AS route,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'server.turn_duration_ms' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS turns,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'server.turn_ttft_ms' THEN value END), 0) AS ttft_avg_ms,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'server.turn_duration_ms' THEN value END) / 1000.0, 1) AS turn_avg_s,
  CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'server.turn_tool_calls' THEN value ELSE 0 END), 0) AS INTEGER) AS tool_starts,
  ROUND(
    CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'server.turn_tool_calls' THEN value ELSE 0 END), 0) AS REAL)
    / MAX(1, SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'server.turn_duration_ms' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)),
    2
  ) AS tools_per_turn,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'server.turn_cost' THEN value ELSE 0 END) / 1000000.0, 2) AS cost_usd,
  ROUND(
    (SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'server.turn_cost' THEN value ELSE 0 END) / 1000000.0)
    / MAX(1, SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'server.turn_duration_ms' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)),
    4
  ) AS usd_per_turn,
  ROUND(
    SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'server.turn_cost' THEN value ELSE 0 END)
    / MAX(1.0, SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'server.turn_output_tokens' THEN value ELSE 0 END) * 1000.0),
    4
  ) AS usd_per_1k_out,
  CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'server.turn_output_tokens' THEN value ELSE 0 END), 0) AS INTEGER) AS output_tokens,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'server.turn_error' THEN value ELSE 0 END)
    / MAX(1, SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'server.turn_duration_ms' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)),
    1
  ) AS turn_err_pct,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'server.tool_result' AND json_extract(tags_json, '$.status') = 'error' THEN value ELSE 0 END)
    / MAX(1, SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'server.tool_result' THEN value ELSE 0 END)),
    1
  ) AS tool_err_pct
FROM server_ops_metric_samples
WHERE metric IN ('server.turn_ttft_ms','server.turn_duration_ms','server.turn_error','server.turn_tool_calls','server.turn_output_tokens','server.turn_cost','server.tool_result')
  AND ts_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider')), ''), 'untagged') IN (${provider:sqlstring})
  AND (CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider'), '')), '') IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.model'), '')), '') IS NULL THEN 'untagged' ELSE json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider') || '/' || json_extract(tags_json, '$.model') END) IN (${route:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1
HAVING turns > 0 OR tool_starts > 0 OR cost_usd > 0
ORDER BY CASE WHEN route = 'untagged' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, cost_usd DESC, turns DESC

  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'server.tool_result' AND json_extract(tags_json, '$.status') = 'error' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS errors,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'server.tool_result' AND json_extract(tags_json, '$.status') = 'error' THEN value ELSE 0 END)
    / MAX(1, SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'server.tool_result' THEN value ELSE 0 END)),
    1
  ) AS err_pct
FROM server_ops_metric_samples
WHERE metric IN ('server.tool_result', 'server.tool_duration_ms')
  AND ts_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider')), ''), 'untagged') IN (${provider:sqlstring})
  AND (CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider'), '')), '') IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.model'), '')), '') IS NULL THEN 'untagged' ELSE json_extract(tags_json, '$.provider') || '/' || json_extract(tags_json, '$.model') END) IN (${route:sqlstring})
